fields.label: What must the proposed specification change?

risks.mitigation: Add one targeted oakridge-dbos test invocation and report its actual output separately; if it cannot run, record that as a known issue rather than treating unrelated output as coverage.
risks.description: The assessment could overstate T1 verification by attaching observation-suite output to a finding about oakridge-dbos behavior that the suite did not execute.

risks.mitigation: Use the builders published head_sha as the assessors immutable subject, as the specification already requires.
risks.description: The named branch can move between stages, causing builder and assessor to inspect different commits if they rely on the branch name rather than the recorded SHA.

body.summary: The audit is implementable without an operator decision or compatibility blocker. The locally available PR head is 3ad8cadbc809e84edf231b32e77661fcf468dd6f, descended from the worktree base b442f99ccdd68699a346ee55dd9fbe27bc3335d0. T1 has direct code and committed unit-test coverage for default-off grading and launch-config delivery; T2 has a claim-attempt/owner/lease fence and transactional completion-plus-observation coverage. One warning remains: the sole mandated builder command runs only the observation package, so its output does not execute T1s oakridge-dbos tests despite the assessor requirement to cite test/output evidence for every finding.

findings.description: T1 is concrete and reviewable at the target commit: RunConfig names grading_enabled, parseRunConfig defaults an omitted property to false and rejects non-booleans, and launched-event mapping forwards the committed config beside the input (oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:7-11, oakridge-dbos/src/domain/run-config.ts:21-42, oakridge-dbos/src/adapters/observation-mapping.ts:42-49).

The first half of T2 is concrete and reviewable: fenced selects only a claimed row matching tenant, execution id, lease owner, claim attempt, and an unexpired lease under FOR UPDATE; request marking and every settlement call use that fence (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:193-215, observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:227-280, observation/src/grading/worker.ts:71-101).

The second half of T2 is independently verifiable: completeExecution updates the execution, closes the matching provider attempt, and inserts the grade observation inside one withTenant transaction, while the integration test proves a rejected observation insert rolls back completion and a valid retry commits both (observation/src/storage/execution-store.ts:227-254, observation/tests/execution-lifecycle.test.ts:226-239).

The required builder command bun run --filter observation test executes observation/package.jsons test script only, while T1s direct tests live in oakridge-dbos and therefore will not appear in the mandated output. The committed T1 tests cover omitted grading as false, exact boolean preservation, invalid values, and launch mapping (observation/package.json:6-8, oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts:56-83, oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts:50-65). Without a targeted oakridge-dbos run, an assessor can cite those test files as code but cannot honestly claim the reported builder test output exercised T1.

requirements.description: Produce exactly one cohort named audit with exactly T1 and T2; the task boundaries are explicit and require no operator choice.
Audit grading_enabled default-off parsing and preservation through launched-event delivery at the PR-head commit.
Audit exact-current-claim fencing and atomic execution completion plus observation append at the same commit.
Detach to the locally available head ref, make no source or remote changes, run the specified test command once, report actual results or a known issue, and publish the existing PR metadata.

Assess the builders recorded head_sha without mutation, with at least one file-and-line finding per task and separate test/output evidence; the warning identifies how to make T1s executed evidence direct rather than merely adjacent.

proposed_spec_updates.change: After bun run --filter observation test, add one targeted run: bun test oakridge-dbos/tests/run-config.test.ts oakridge-dbos/tests/observation-mapping.test.ts. Require build_result and assessor test_evidence to report each commands actual counts and output separately; an un-runnable command remains a known issue.
proposed_spec_updates.reason: The existing required command covers the observation package and T2 but does not execute the direct T1 tests, so the added command makes the per-finding test/output citation accurate without broadening the audit or changing code.
